summary: The filing reports Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A.'s Board of Directors approval of a management proposal to merge Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the Company, subject to an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 30, 2026. No financial terms (price, premium, value) are disclosed. The board unanimously approved based on the Audit Committee's favorable recommendation; PricewaterhouseCoopers was engaged to prepare the appraisal report. The merger follows Brazilian corporate law (Article 227 of Law 6,404/76). As a non-US filing on Form 6-K, this maps to a US merger announcement. Per-share consideration and other deal specifics are absent. Watch for EGM vote and appraisal outcomes; limited near-term arbitrage without pricing details.
